x: The back markers in the handicap could well complain, for if the full distance had been covered there is little doubt that Walker and Moore would have been among the prizes.
Then followed a string of runners before we again saw a Belgrave vest filled by Eddie Short who had John Moore and Jumbo Masters close on his heels, all of them in the 130's.

At the end of the first lap Clive Shippen was leading with Moore and Short well in attendance. A quick check showed that we were well in the lead and should have no difficulty in holding our position.
Mike Maynard set a fast pace at the start and was comfortably leading after a mile from John Moore and Chris Thompson with Clive Shippen and the Blackheath captain, A.W.

Their lead was, however, gradually cut down and on the third lap the leading bunch was comprised of Newell, Walker, Moore and Bedford. During the second mile Pat broke away and was never again headed, while Don Maclean made one of his typical surges through the field to join the battle for 2nd. plac…
John Moore showed that he was back on form once again, pegging back two more positions on the fourth leg to place us 4th at halfway, only 68secs behind the leaders.
Our first team,made up of Shippen, Black, Walker, Robinson, Stearman and Moore wandered between thirteenth and ninth before settling in tenth place- a position far below their capabilities.
A few weeks later we travelled to West Bromwich for the National, without such stars as Newell (unfit) Bhatia and Moore; both of whom are ineligible for birth reasons.
Forey 12:48 Hart 14:06 Smart 13:47 Shippen 12:58 Penny 13:37 Moore 13:36 Johnstone 13:05 D.Newell 14:39 Asten 14:25 Beaumont 15:30

Heck, Miller, Thresher, Moore and Johnston are but a few knocking on the door to 1st team honours. There are also those up-and-coming lads Cocks, Hampshire and Fairclough who will be dis-placing a few old-timers before long.

We hope that by then we have Bill Kerr Ron Linstead and Alan Black back with us, and also see such people as Miller Moore and our up-and-coming Juniors making competition for those coveted team positions really hot.
After all, how is this for a depleted ten? - Black, Brown, Barrow, Kerr, O'Hara, Newell, Bicourt, Thorpe, Moore and Walker. It would be an even greater feat to win both trophies!
